sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普林。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会当DJ时，你每天晚上都要带着30米的最宝贵藏品去上班，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成这样一个犹如充满美感的50年历史文物的生动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the Republican push to release the memo has brought attention back to FISA and the years-long battle over when national security should trump civil liberties.
sentences.zh: 今天，共和党人推动公开备忘录的举动，让人们重新关注FISA，以及多年来关于国家安全何时应凌驾于公民自由之上的激烈博弈。

sentences.en: The surprising thing this time is which side Republicans have chosen.
sentences.zh: 这次令人惊讶的是，共和党人选择了站在哪一边。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月6日，星期二。

sentences.en: You're reporting tonight the FBI obtained a FISA warrant on Carter Page, a Trump campaign advisor.
sentences.zh: 你今晚的报道称，联邦调查局获得了一份针对特朗普竞选顾问卡特·佩奇的FISA搜查令。

sentences.en: Republicans allege that the memo details abuses in the FISA warrant.
sentences.zh: 共和党人声称该备忘录详细列举了FISA搜查令中的滥用行为。

sentences.en: Four times FBI officials went to a federal surveillance court.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局官员四次前往联邦监视法院。

sentences.en: Were those wiretaps attained through a FISA warrant that was based on the Trump does?
sentences.zh: 这些窃听是通过基于特朗普档案的FISA搜查令获得的吗？

sentences.en: Used in this secret court that we can't watch the proceedings of.
sentences.zh: 用于这个我们无法观看其审理程序的秘密法庭。

sentences.en: That the memo centers on this question of the FISA application.
sentences.zh: 该备忘录的核心正是这个关于FISA申请的问题。

sentences.en: The FISA court was fooled by a warrant.
sentences.zh: FISA法院被一张搜查令给蒙蔽了。

sentences.en: FISA warrant?
sentences.zh: FISA搜查令？

sentences.en: FISA judge.
sentences.zh: FISA法官。

sentences.en: FISA, FISA, FISA.
sentences.zh: FISA，FISA，FISA。

sentences.en: Charlie, what is FISA?
sentences.zh: 查理，什么是FISA？

sentences.en: FISA is the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act.
sentences.zh: FISA是《外国情报监视法》。

sentences.en: Charlie Savage covers national security and the law.
sentences.zh: 查理·萨维奇报道国家安全与法律。

sentences.en: It is a law that was passed by Congress in 1978 to regulate and govern the government's wiretapping on domestic soil for the purpose of national security.
sentences.zh: 这是一部由国会在1978年通过的法律，旨在为了国家安全的目的，对政府在本土进行的窃听行为进行监管和治理。

sentences.en: That is, for looking for spies and members of terrorist groups and agents of foreign governments and organizations that may be operating here on domestic soil,
sentences.zh: 也就是说，为了搜寻可能在国内本土活动的间谍、恐怖组织成员以及外国政府和组织的代理人，

sentences.en: as opposed to ordinary solve-the-crime criminal investigation wiretaps, which are governed by a different law and a different set of procedures.
sentences.zh: 这与普通解决犯罪的刑事调查窃听不同，后者受不同的法律和一套不同的程序管辖。

sentences.en: There has never been a full public accounting of FBI domestic intelligence operations.
sentences.zh: 从来没有对联邦调查局国内情报行动进行过全面公开的交代。

sentences.en: Therefore, this committee has undertaken such an investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，本委员会承担了这样一项调查。

sentences.en: In the 70s, amid the fallout from Watergate and the end of the Vietnam War and the general period of distrust in the government and revelations of government wrongdoing,
sentences.zh: 在70年代，在水门事件余波、越南战争结束以及对政府普遍不信任和政府违法行为被揭露的时期，

sentences.en: was something called the Church Committee.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫做丘奇委员会的机构。

sentences.en: Its purpose is not to impair the FBI's legitimate law enforcement and counter espionage functions,
sentences.zh: 其目的不是削弱联邦调查局合法的执法和反间谍职能，

sentences.en: but rather to evaluate domestic intelligence according to the standards of the Constitution and the statutes of our land.
sentences.zh: 而是根据宪法标准和我国的成文法来评估国内情报。

sentences.en: A congressional oversight investigation into years of intelligence abuses by presidents of both parties,
sentences.zh: 这是一项针对两党总统多年来情报滥用行为的国会监督调查，

sentences.en: one aspect of which was using intelligence wiretapping to spy on their domestic political opponents.
sentences.zh: 其中的一个方面就是利用情报窃听来监视国内政治对手。

sentences.en: And we have seen today the dark side of those activities where many Americans who were not even suspected of crime were not only spied upon, but they were harassed,
sentences.zh: 我们今天已经看到了这些活动的黑暗面，许多甚至没有被怀疑犯罪的美国人不仅遭到监视，还被骚扰，

sentences.en: they were discredited.
sentences.zh: 他们被抹黑。

sentences.en: They were spying on civil rights leaders, lawmakers of the other party,
sentences.zh: 他们监视民权领袖、另一党的议员、

sentences.en: labor union leaders undertaken in the name of looking for Soviet communist subversive influences in those who were against whoever was president at the time.
sentences.zh: 工会领袖，这些行动打着寻找苏联共产主义颠覆势力影响以及那些反对当时总统的人的幌子进行。

sentences.en: But really, this was an abuse.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这是一次滥用。

sentences.en: And the most famous example of that was the FBI spying on Martin Luther King Jr.
sentences.zh: 其中最著名的例子就是联邦调查局监视小马丁·路德·金，

sentences.en: and then trying to blackmail him with information they had gathered about his extramarital affairs.
sentences.zh: 然后试图利用他们收集到的关于他婚外情的资料来勒索他。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This development of the concept of nonviolent confrontation or nonviolent protests was seen as a threat to law enforcement and something the Bureau was indeed unhappy about.
sentences.zh: 这种非暴力对抗或非暴力抗议的概念的发展被视为对执法部门的威胁，也是局里确实感到不满的事情。

sentences.en: The plan here is to completely discredit Dr. King by, quote, taking him off his pedestal and to reduce him completely in influence.
sentences.zh: 这里的计划是通过所谓的“将其拉下神坛”并彻底削弱其影响力来彻底抹黑金博士。

sentences.en: And so Congress began negotiating to enact a statute that would regulate national security wiretapping inside the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，国会开始协商制定一项法规，以规范美国国内的国家安全窃听。

sentences.en: Among the important things about FISA is that it created a court to hear applications from the Justice Department on behalf of the FBI, usually, or the NSA,
sentences.zh: FISA的重要之处在于它创建了一个法庭，听取司法部代表通常是联邦调查局或国安局提出的申请，

sentences.en: to target someone on American soil for this purpose.
sentences.zh: 以出于此目的将美国本土的某个人作为目标。

sentences.en: And it required the government, when wiretapping on domestic soil, to get a warrant from a judge on that court or else it would be illegal to wiretap.
sentences.zh: 它要求政府在本土进行窃听时，必须从该法庭的法官那里获得搜查令，否则窃听就是非法的。

sentences.en: So once a FISA judge approves a request, what is the NSA or the FBI or whoever has asked for a warrant likely to do from there?
sentences.zh: 那么，一旦FISA法官批准了一项请求，国安局、联邦调查局或其他任何要求搜查令的人接下来可能会做什么？

sentences.en: So they get their order.
sentences.zh: 所以他们拿到了命令。

sentences.en: The order says, yes, you may have authority to wiretap this person for the next 90 days.
sentences.zh: 命令说，可以，你在接下来的90天里有权窃听这个人。

sentences.en: The judge will also have decided that there's probable cause that the target is likely to use certain facilities, is the term of art.
sentences.zh: 法官还将裁定，有相当理由相信目标可能会使用某些“设施”，这是一个专业术语。

sentences.en: And a facility could be something like a phone number or an email address to communicate.
sentences.zh: 而设施可能是诸如用于交流的电话号码或电子邮箱地址之类的事物。

sentences.en: The judge will also issue secondary orders to providers.
sentences.zh: 法官还将向提供商发布辅助命令。

sentences.en: The secondary order will say, Google or AT&T, you are ordered to provide surreptitious access to the communications of this target for the next 90 days.
sentences.zh: 辅助命令会说，谷歌或美国电话电报公司，你们被命令在接下来的90天内提供对该目标通信的秘密访问权限。

sentences.en: And so the FBI will then take that to the provider and the wiretap will commence.
sentences.zh: 因此，联邦调查局随后将把该命令带给提供商，窃听随即开始。

sentences.en: So as a country, we don't really hear or grapple with this law, FISA, again, really until September 11th, 2001, right?
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个国家，我们实际上并没有真正听到或处理FISA这部法律，直到2001年9月11日，对吧？

sentences.en: The public does not hear much about FISA until well after 9-11.
sentences.zh: 公众直到9·11之后很久才听到太多关于FISA的信息。

sentences.en: But behind the scenes, there was a growing problem with FISA.
sentences.zh: 但在幕后，FISA正面临着一个日益严重的问题。

sentences.en: And the problem was this.
sentences.zh: 问题在于：

sentences.en: FISA was written to cover the technology of its era.
sentences.zh: FISA的起草是为了涵盖其时代的技术。

sentences.en: And it was carefully written so that the kind of bulk surveillance of international communications were not covered by FISA in 1978.
sentences.zh: 它经过精心起草，使得1978年的FISA并不涵盖对国际通信的大规模监视。

sentences.en: But then technology started to change.
sentences.zh: 但随后技术开始改变。

sentences.en: There's two ways in which, in this era, the communications of people all around the world are increasingly available from domestic soil.
sentences.zh: 在这个时代，世界各地人们的通信越来越多地可以从国内本土获取，途径主要有两种。

sentences.en: One is because the United States invented the internet and had a huge head start in laying down fiber optic cable, we act as sort of a hub to the global network.
sentences.zh: 一是由于美国发明了互联网，并在铺设光缆方面占据了巨大的先机，我们充当了全球网络的某种枢纽。

sentences.en: Compounding that, Silicon Valley invents free email available to anyone with a web browser through services like Hotmail and now Gmail.
sentences.zh: 雪上加霜的是，硅谷通过Hotmail和现在的Gmail等服务，发明了任何拥有网页浏览器的人都可以使用的免费电子邮件。

sentences.en: Anyone can get an account anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上任何地方的任何人都可以拥有一个账户。

sentences.en: And their messages, especially at first, are routed to Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 他们的信息，尤其是在最初，会被路由到硅谷。

sentences.en: And they sit there until someone else who also has an account, even though they may also be a foreigner, logs into their email to retrieve them.
sentences.zh: 它们就静静地呆在那里，直到另一个同样拥有账户的人——尽管他们可能也是外国人——登录他们的电子邮件来检索它们。

sentences.en: And so the messages are also inside the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此这些信息也留在了美国境内。

sentences.en: So for both of these reasons, there's a rich stream of global communications crossing the backyard of the NSA.
sentences.zh: 因此，由于这两个原因，有一股源源不断的全球通信流正穿过国安局的后院。

sentences.en: But if it intercepts them on domestic soil, that is covered by FISA.
sentences.zh: 但如果它在本土拦截这些通信，这就属于FISA的管辖范围。

sentences.en: Because FISA covers interception from a wire on domestic soil.
sentences.zh: 因为FISA涵盖了对国内本土电线拦截的行为。

sentences.en: And this set off a slow motion crisis inside the intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 这在情报界内部引发了一场慢动作危机。

sentences.en: And so into the 90s, as the internet grew explosively, it became a bigger and bigger problem from the vantage point of the NSA.
sentences.zh: 因此进入90年代，随着互联网爆炸式增长，从国安局的角度来看，这成了一个越来越大的问题。

sentences.en: And that brings us to 9-11.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了9·11。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的舞台上现场亮相。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实时发生。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于nytimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，畅享我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: So how does the September 11th attack intersect with everything that you've just laid out for us?
sentences.zh: 那么9·11袭击与你刚才向我们阐述的一切是如何交织在一起的呢？

sentences.en: So leading up to 9-11, these pressures of the inability of the NSA to access these foreign communications became more and more acute.
sentences.zh: 所以在9·11之前，国安局无法访问这些外国通信的压力变得越来越尖锐。

sentences.en: And it was a conversation happening inside classified circles inside the executive branch because they did not want to disclose that this had become a problem because that would also tell the world.
sentences.zh: 这是行政部门内部机密圈子里进行的一场对话，因为他们不想透露这已经成为一个问题，因为那也会告诉世界，

sentences.en: that, hey, your communications are actually crossing our soil where we can dip into them.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你们的通信实际上正穿过我们的本土，我们可以从中窥探。

sentences.en: On 9-11, of course, the United States is attacked and everything changes.
sentences.zh: 当然，在9·11当天，美国遭到袭击，一切都变了。

sentences.en: Conversation shifts far away from any concern about civil liberties, to say the least, but also the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 对话的重心远远偏离了对公民自由的任何关切，更不用说对法治的关切了。

sentences.en: And so I asked people in my administration to analyze how best for me and our government to do the job people expect us to do,
sentences.zh: 所以我要求我政府中的人们分析，我和我们的政府如何才能最好地完成人们期望我们完成的工作，

sentences.en: which is to detect and prevent a possible attack.
sentences.zh: 那就是侦测并防止可能的袭击。

sentences.en: That's what the American people want.
sentences.zh: 这正是美国人民想要的。

sentences.en: The proposal arises to start wiretapping communications with one in the United States and one in abroad without obeying FISA.
sentences.zh: 随后出现了一项提议，即开始在不遵守FISA的情况下，对一方在美国境内、一方在国外的通信进行窃听。

sentences.en: By making the secret claim the President Bush need not obey this statute because he's the commander-in-chief and this is war and Congress cannot constitutionally tie his hands
sentences.zh: 通过提出一个秘密主张，即布什总统不必遵守这项法规，因为他是三军统帅，这是一场战争，国会在宪法上不能束缚他的手脚，

sentences.en: against doing something that he thinks is necessary to protect national security.
sentences.zh: 使他无法采取其认为保护国家安全所必需的行动。

sentences.en: And so from that secret claim arises the secret Stellar Wind program, better known as the Warrantless Wiretapping Program or the Terrorism Surveillance Program
sentences.zh: 因此，从这个秘密主张中诞生了秘密的“星风”计划，也就是人们更熟悉的无证窃听计划或恐怖主义监视计划，

sentences.en: as the Bush administration dubbed it when it came to light because in 2005, the New York Times disclosed its existence.
sentences.zh: 正如布什政府在它曝光时给它起的名字那样，因为在2005年，《纽约时报》披露了它的存在。

sentences.en: My personal opinion is
sentences.zh: 我个人的看法是

sentences.en: It was a shameful act for someone to disclose this very important program in time of war.
sentences.zh: 在战争时期，有人泄露这个极其重要的计划，是一种可耻的行为。

sentences.en: The fact that we're discussing this program is helping the enemy.
sentences.zh: 我们正在讨论这个计划的事实正在帮助敌人。

sentences.en: The Times report set off a firestorm about civil liberties and the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的报道引发了一场关于公民自由和法治的风暴。

sentences.en: When I read that front page story, before I even finished it, I mean, after I read the headline, I was sending emails to sort of everybody within the ACLU.
sentences.zh: 当我读到那篇头版报道时，甚至还没看完，我是说，在读完标题后，我就开始给美国公民自由联盟内的差不多所有人发电子邮件。

sentences.en: We got to get on the phone immediately.
sentences.zh: 我们必须马上通电话。

sentences.en: I think the executive branch and the presidency were designed specifically by the framers of our Constitution
sentences.zh: 我认为行政部门和总统职位是由我们宪法的制定者专门设计的，

sentences.en: to take charge in moments of emergency, to take charge in moments of war.
sentences.zh: 以便在紧急时刻接管，在战争时刻接管。

sentences.en: Do you presume that all your phone calls are monitored in some way by the NSA?
sentences.zh: 你是否认为你的所有电话都以某种方式受到国安局的监控？

sentences.en: No, of course not.
sentences.zh: 不，当然没有。

sentences.en: Your cell phone calls?
sentences.zh: 你的手机通话？

sentences.en: Anything?
sentences.zh: 任何内容？

sentences.en: No, but I would never talk.
sentences.zh: 没有，但我绝不会谈论……

sentences.en: And finally, it's resolved in 2007 and 2008 with the enactment of what we now call the FISA Amendments Act or Section 702, sometimes people call it.
sentences.zh: 最后，随着我们现在所称的《FISA修正案法案》或有时人们所称的“第702条款”的颁布，这个问题在2007年和2008年得到了解决。

sentences.en: The legislation I'm signing today will ensure that our intelligence community professionals have the tools.
sentences.zh: 我今天签署的这项立法将确保我们的情报界专业人士拥有工具。

sentences.en: They need to protect our country in the years to come.
sentences.zh: 他们需要保护我们国家在未来几年的安全。

sentences.en: And that carves out a hole in FISA.
sentences.zh: 这在FISA中撕开了一个口子。

sentences.en: It creates an exemption to say you don't need a warrant.
sentences.zh: 它创造了一个豁免条款，说明你不需要搜查令。

sentences.en: You can have a warrantless surveillance program as long as the target is a non-citizen abroad.
sentences.zh: 只要目标是身在国外的非美国公民，你就可以实施无证监视计划。

sentences.en: The bill will allow our intelligence professionals to quickly and effectively monitor the communications of terrorists abroad while respecting the liberties of Americans here at home.
sentences.zh: 该法案将允许我们的情报专业人士迅速有效地监控境外恐怖分子的通信，同时尊重国内美国人的自由。

sentences.en: And that sort of legalizes and normalizes the Warrantless Survey Once program.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上使无证监视计划合法化和常规化了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, ordinary FISA, FBI-style wiretaps of people inside the United States, are continuing along just as they've been doing since 1978,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，针对美国境内人员的普通FISA、联邦调查局风格的窃听仍在继续，就像自1978年以来一直在做的那样，

sentences.en: with applications going to a judge and judges issuing individualized orders.
sentences.zh: 申请提交给法官，法官发布个性化的命令。

sentences.en: Yet you are describing the very elements of a palace coup.
sentences.zh: 然而你正在描述一场宫廷政变的种种要素。

sentences.en: And after Jim and Mark Meadows and many others of us reviewed the intelligence information today,
sentences.zh: 在吉姆、马克·米多斯以及我们许多其他人今天审查了情报信息之后，

sentences.en: it is abundantly clear that the entire Mueller investigation is a lie built on a foundation of corruption.
sentences.zh: 非常明显，整个穆勒调查都是一个建立在腐败基础上的谎言。

sentences.en: — And how do these changes to the law help us understand the debate happening now around Carter Page and this memo from House Republicans?
sentences.zh: ——这些法律变更为我们理解当前围绕卡特·佩奇以及众议院共和党人这份备忘录的辩论有何帮助？

sentences.en: — These changes to the law we've been discussing, these pressures, the sell or win program, the reform have in total almost nothing at all to do with Carter Page.
sentences.zh: ——我们一直在讨论的这些法律变更、这些压力、星风计划、改革，总体而言与卡特·佩奇几乎没有任何关系。

sentences.en: We think that he was under investigation as far back as 2013 by the FBI because he was talking to Russian spies and they thought he was the target of an attempt to recruit him.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，早在2013年他就因与俄罗斯间谍交谈而受到联邦调查局的调查，他们认为他是试图对其进行招募的目标。

sentences.en: He eventually becomes a foreign policy advisor to the Trump campaign and he goes to Moscow in June of 2016,
sentences.zh: 他最终成为特朗普竞选团队的外交政策顾问，并于2016年6月前往莫斯科，

sentences.en: just as these reports that Russia is trying to mess with the election are starting to bubble up.
sentences.zh: 正值关于俄罗斯试图干预大选的这些报道开始涌现之时。

sentences.en: In September, as reports of Carter Page's Russian ties are coming to the surface, he quits the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 9月份，随着卡特·佩奇与俄罗斯联系的报道浮出水面，他退出了特朗普竞选团队。

sentences.en: And then in October, the FBI applies to the FISA court for permission to wiretap him.
sentences.zh: 然后在10月份，联邦调查局向FISA法院申请批准对其进行窃听。

sentences.en: And to target an American,
sentences.zh: 要将一个美国人作为目标，

sentences.en: you need an ordinary bread and butter FISA order of the sort that were conceived of in 1978 and have been issued all along despite these sideshow of the NSA warrantless wiretapping program.
sentences.zh: 你需要一份1978年构想的、尽管有国安局无证窃听计划这个插曲但一直都在发布的普通FISA常规命令。

sentences.en: And is the FBI granted permission to do this kind of investigation by a FISA court?
sentences.zh: FISA法院是否批准了联邦调查局进行这种调查的许可？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we now know from the Nunes memo, which President Trump declassified,
sentences.zh: 我们现在从特朗普总统解密的努内斯备忘录中得知，

sentences.en: that the government goes back to the FISA court three more times and gets 90-day extensions of that authority, which means probably a collection of different judges,
sentences.zh: 政府三次返回FISA法院，获得了该授权的90天延长，这意味着可能有几位不同的法官，

sentences.en: because there's only one sitting per week,
sentences.zh: 因为每周只有一位在任法官，

sentences.en: looked at the evidence and signed off on the finding that Mr. Page was probably an agent of foreign power or conspiring with one knowingly.
sentences.zh: 审查了证据并签署了以下认定：佩奇先生可能是外国势力的代理人，或者知情并与外国势力勾结。

sentences.en: This is bigger than anything anybody can imagine.
sentences.zh: 这比任何人能想象的都要大。

sentences.en: When you say that, this makes Watergate like stealing a Snickers bar from a drugstore.
sentences.zh: 当你这么说时，这让水门事件看起来就像从药店偷了一块士力架糖果一样。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And what is so controversial about this that's led to this memo being created by House Republicans?
sentences.zh: 这有什么争议，以至于导致众议院共和党人制作了这份备忘录？

sentences.en: Is it that they keep going back and trying to renew this warrant or what?
sentences.zh: 是因为他们不断回去试图续签这个搜查令还是怎么回事？

sentences.en: The essence of the complaint by House Republicans is that the FBI and the Justice Department, to obtain this order from a FISA court judge, or really a sequence of them,
sentences.zh: 众议院共和党人投诉的核心是，联邦调查局和司法部为了从FISA法庭法官（或者实际上是一连串法官）那里获得这项命令，

sentences.en: used information gathered by Christopher Steele, the author of the notorious Steele dossier.
sentences.zh: 使用了由臭名昭著的斯蒂尔档案的作者克里斯托弗·斯蒂尔收集的信息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The allegations were part of a two-page synopsis compiled by a former British intelligence operative whose past work U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些指控是一名前英国情报特工编制的两页梗概的一部分，该特工过去的工作美国

sentences.en: intelligence officials consider credible.
sentences.zh: 情报官员认为是可信的。

sentences.en: He gathered information on behalf of an opposition research firm called Fusion GPS on Russia and Trump and their ties.
sentences.zh: 他代表一家名为Fusion GPS的反对派研究公司收集了有关俄罗斯、特朗普及其联系人的信息。

sentences.en: And the essence of their complaint is that the Justice Department did not adequately explain to the FISA court judge that
sentences.zh: 他们投诉的核心是，司法部没有充分向FISA法庭法官解释

sentences.en: Democrats were paying Fusion GPS for that opposition research at the time.
sentences.zh: 民主党人当时正向Fusion GPS支付费用以进行该反对派调查。

sentences.en: And so the essence of their complaint is the judge was misled, that this information was politically motivated and might be biased, and therefore it might not be credible.
sentences.zh: 因此他们抱怨的实质是法官受到了误导，这些信息是出于政治动机的，可能带有偏见，因此可能并不可信。

sentences.en: Today, when I read the material, I had that same shock feeling.
sentences.zh: 今天，当我阅读这些材料时，我有了那种同样的震惊感。

sentences.en: I was like, wait a minute, this actually happened from our Justice Department and this FBI.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，等一下，这竟然是由我们的司法部和这个联邦调查局发生的。

sentences.en: That's how serious this is.
sentences.zh: 这就是这件事的严重性所在。

sentences.en: That's why we're called.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们会被召集。

sentences.en: What are the problems with that claim from House Republicans?
sentences.zh: 众议院共和党人的这种说法有什么问题？

sentences.en: So other people in Congress and elsewhere who are familiar with the underlying FISA court application say that the Nunes memo is misleading and mischaracterizes the information in several material ways.
sentences.zh: 因此，国会和其他熟悉FISA法院底层申请的人士表示，努内斯备忘录具有误导性，并在几个实质性方面歪曲了信息。

sentences.en: One is that they say that the judge was told that the Steele opposition research had a political motivation.
sentences.zh: 一是他们说，法官被告知斯蒂尔的反对派调查具有政治动机。

sentences.en: They also apparently omit all kinds of other unrelated to Steele evidence that was submitted to the judge about Mr. Page, about the Trump campaign,
sentences.zh: 他们显然还遗漏了提交给法官的、关于佩奇先生、关于特朗普竞选团队的、与斯蒂尔完全无关的各种其他证据，

sentences.en: about Russia's efforts in general that came from other sources and methods.
sentences.zh: 以及来自其他来源和方法的、关于俄罗斯总体努力的证据。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I can say because we know from public sources that there's a lot that the FBI knew about Carter Page that had nothing to do with Christopher Steele's reporting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我可以这么说，因为我们从公开渠道得知，联邦调查局掌握了许多关于卡特·佩奇的情况，这些情况与克里斯托弗·斯蒂尔的报道毫无关系。

sentences.en: Carter Page had come to the attention of the FBI, indeed, years before he joined the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在卡特·佩奇加入特朗普竞选团队的几年前，他就已经进入了联邦调查局的视线。

sentences.en: And therefore, misleadingly exaggerates the relative importance of the Steele information within the larger package.
sentences.zh: 因此，它误导性地夸大了斯蒂尔信息在整个更大打包文件中的相对重要性。

sentences.en: But if you read the memo, it's very misleading.
sentences.zh: 但如果你读了这份备忘录，就会发现它非常具有误导性。

sentences.en: And that's the whole nature of this document.
sentences.zh: 这就是这份文件的全部本质。

sentences.en: Charlie, knowing what you do about FISA's history and the intent of the law, what do you make of how it's now being debated in the context of this Carter-Page controversy?
sentences.zh: 查理，结合你对FISA历史和法律意图的了解，你如何看待它现在在这个卡特·佩奇争议的背景下被讨论？

sentences.en: One of the interesting things about this is that ordinary FISA,
sentences.zh: 这里有趣的事情之一是，普通的FISA，

sentences.en: the kind with judges and applications and the necessity of an independent judicial finding that someone was probably an agent of a foreign power, is not that controversial.
sentences.zh: 那种有法官、有申请、并且需要独立的司法认定某人可能是外国代理人的FISA，其实并没有那么大争议。

sentences.en: We've had tremendous controversy since 9-11 about surveillance, but it's been about the warrantless kind.
sentences.zh: 自9·11事件以来，我们围绕监控产生了巨大的争议，但那都是关于无搜查令的监控。

sentences.en: So it's quite interesting that the meat and potatoes, ordinary FISA is now at the subject of this intense controversy.
sentences.zh: 所以非常有趣的是，作为核心基础的普通FISA现在成了这场激烈争议的主题。

sentences.en: And that also, by the way, is one of the ways we can judge what Republicans are now saying about what their intention and motivation is in focusing on this matter.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这也是我们判断共和党人现在对其专注此事的意图和动机的说法的一种方式。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, just in January last month, that warrantless surveillance law, Section 702, came up for renewal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在今年一月，上个月，那个无搜查令监控法，即第702条款，面临续签。

sentences.en: And with Devin Nunes as the chief architect and Paul Ryan as perhaps the most important player or one of them,
sentences.zh: 在德文·努内斯作为主要策划者、保罗·瑞恩作为最重要的参与者之一的推动下，

sentences.en: they pushed through in Congress a six-year extension of that law while turning back an effort by reformers to impose more safeguards for the protection of Americans' communications when it gets sucked into that program.
sentences.zh: 他们在国会强行通过了该法律的六年延期，同时击退了改革派试图施加更多保障措施的努力，以在保护美国人的通信内容被吸入该计划时不受侵犯。

sentences.en: And so it's hard to reconcile that move in January with the claim now that they are simply interested in protecting civil liberties and are worried that a cabal of executive branch national security officials may have abused their authority to obtain this surveillance under false pretenses.
sentences.zh: 因此，很难将一月份的这一举动与他们现在的声称调和起来——他们现在声称自己只是对保护公民自由感兴趣，并担心行政部门的国家安全官员可能会滥用职权以虚假借口获得这种监控。

sentences.en: because people who are worried that executive branch officials might abuse their surveillance authorities
sentences.zh: 因为那些担心行政部门官员可能会滥用监控权力的人，

sentences.en: probably would have voted the other way last month when it came to this warrantless surveillance program
sentences.zh: 在上个月涉及这个无搜查令监控计划时，可能会投出相反的票，

sentences.en: rather than turning back an attempt to prevent abuses by putting in more safeguards.
sentences.zh: 而不是通过加入更多保障措施来阻止滥用行为的尝试。

sentences.en: There are legitimate questions about whether an American's civil liberties were violated by the FISA process.
sentences.zh: 对于美国人的公民自由是否被FISA程序侵犯，存在着合理的质疑。

sentences.en: The American citizens that are represented before this court have to be protected.
sentences.zh: 在这个法庭面前代表的美国公民必须受到保护。

sentences.en: And the only place that can protect them is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而唯一能在滥用行为发生时保护他们的，就是美国

sentences.en: Congress when abuses do occur.
sentences.zh: 国会。

sentences.en: Our civil liberties are important.
sentences.zh: 我们的公民自由很重要。

sentences.en: They are not burdens.
sentences.zh: 它们不是负担。

sentences.en: Our civil liberties are things that make our country great.
sentences.zh: 我们的公民自由是让我们的国家伟大的事物。

sentences.en: And so that is the focus of the memo of a series of...
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是一系列备忘录的焦点所在……

sentences.en: So if this argument that Republicans are making about FISA seems essentially contradictory to their past actions around FISA,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果共和党人对FISA的这种论点似乎从根本上与他们过去围绕FISA的行动相矛盾，

sentences.en: and if they're treating this ordinary use of FISA as controversial in the first place, where they never have before.
sentences.zh: 并且如果他们把FISA这种常规使用一开始就当作充满争议的事物来对待，而这在以前从未有过。

sentences.en: Does that sort of suggest that this whole debate over the memo isn't really about FISA at all, and that FISA is just sort of a manufactured controversy to mask a partisan fight?
sentences.zh: 这是否暗示了围绕备忘录的这场争论根本不是关于FISA的，FISA只是一种捏造出来的争议，用来掩盖一场党派斗争？

sentences.en: Even if it does turn out to be that this has nothing to do with FISA per se, it still is interesting that it's brought attention onto core FISA,
sentences.zh: 即使事实证明这与FISA本身毫无关系，但它仍然将人们的注意力吸引到了核心FISA上，这依然很有意思，

sentences.en: the original 1978 law that's been governing national security wiretapping in this country for a generation.
sentences.zh: 也就是那部自整整一代人以来一直管辖着这个国家的国家安全窃听活动的1978年原初法律。

sentences.en: One of the interesting things about all this is that no one has ever seen outside of the executive branch and the FISA court an application for a FISA wiretap.
sentences.zh: 关于这一切，有趣的事情之一是，在行政部门和FISA法院之外，从来没有人见过FISA窃听令的申请书。

sentences.en: The government has carefully protected those.
sentences.zh: 政府对这些文件进行了严密保护。

sentences.en: And now, because President Trump has declassified the existence of this application, it's created an opportunity for the public, maybe, to see what those things look like.
sentences.zh: 现在，由于特朗普总统解密了这份申请的存在，这就为公众创造了一个机会，或许能看看那些东西是什么样的。

sentences.en: And so today, for example, I and a colleague here at The New York Times, Adam Goldman,
sentences.zh: 所以今天，例如，《纽约时报》的一位同事亚当·戈德曼和我，

sentences.en: have petitioned the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court to unseal the actual application and make it public with whatever redactions remain necessary.
sentences.zh: 已经向外国情报监视法院请愿，要求解封实际申请书，并在删除任何仍然必要的敏感信息后将其公之于众。

sentences.en: We'll see what happens with that.
sentences.zh: 我们将拭目以待此事的结果。

sentences.en: But it's an opportunity spinning off of this partisan fight to really gain a better understanding of this law we've been living under since 1978.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个顺着这场党派斗争衍生出的机会，能让我们真正更好地了解我们自1978年以来一直生活在其中的这项法律。

sentences.en: On Monday night, the House Intelligence Committee voted unanimously to release the Democratic
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，众议院情报委员会一致投票通过公布民主党的

sentences.en: rebuttal memo, which disputes Republican claims that the FBI and Justice Department abused their powers in seeking the wiretap for Carter Page.
sentences.zh: 反驳备忘录，该备忘录反驳了共和党人关于联邦调查局和司法部在寻求卡特·佩奇窃听令时滥用职权的说法。

sentences.en: President Trump now has five days to review the document and decide whether it should be made public.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统现在有五天时间来审查该文件，并决定是否应当将其公之于众。

sentences.en: If he refuses, the memo will remain classified unless the full House of Representatives votes to override the president.
sentences.zh: 如果他拒绝，除非全体众议院投票推翻总统的决定，否则该备忘录将保持机密状态。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: All right, this is accelerating very steep drops now.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在的暴跌正在加速加剧。

sentences.en: We're five and three quarter percent,
sentences.zh: 我们跌了百分之五点七五，

sentences.en: 1,500 points lower on the Dow.
sentences.zh: 道琼斯指数下跌了1500点。

sentences.en: And you are looking live at something that in history and in point terms we have never seen at the corner of Wall and Raw.
sentences.zh: 你正在直播见证历史上以及在点数上我们从未在华尔街和百老汇街角见过的一幕。

sentences.en: On pace for the worst day since 2008.
sentences.zh: 正朝着2008年以来最糟糕的一天迈进。

sentences.en: Ended with a loss of $1,175 to finish at $24,345.
sentences.zh: 最终收盘下跌1,175美元，报收于24,345美元。

sentences.en: That's a drop of more than 4.5%, the biggest percentage drop since 2011.
sentences.zh: 跌幅超过4.5%，这是自2011年以来最大的百分比跌幅。

sentences.en: The Dow is now negative on the year.
sentences.zh: 道琼斯指数今年以来的涨幅现已抹平。

sentences.en: All of the gains from January and February have now been wiped out.
sentences.zh: 一月和二月的所有涨幅现在都化为乌有。

sentences.en: Days after reaching all-time highs, the stock market plunged on Monday, wiping out nearly a trillion dollars in wealth.
sentences.zh: 在创下历史新高几天后，股市于周一暴跌，蒸发了近一万亿美元的财富。

sentences.en: By the end of the day, markets in the U.S., Europe, and Asia had lost all of their gains for the past year.
sentences.zh: 到一天结束时，美国、欧洲和亚洲的市场已经失去了过去一年的全部涨幅。

sentences.en: In a statement after the markets closed, the White House seemed to distance itself from President Trump's repeated emphasis on the stock market.
sentences.zh: 在市场收盘后的一份声明中，白宫似乎与特朗普总统对股市的反复强调保持了距离。

sentences.en: The president's focus, it said, is on our long-term economic fundamentals, which remain exceptionally strong.
sentences.zh: 声明称，总统的重点是我们的长期经济基本面，这些基本面依然异常强劲。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that lawyers for the president have advised him against sitting down for an interview with special counsel Robert Mueller,
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，总统的律师已建议他不要接受特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒的闭门访谈，

sentences.en: raising the possibility of a long legal battle over whether Trump must answer questions under oath.
sentences.zh: 这就引发了一种长期的法律斗争的可能性，即特朗普是否必须在宣誓后回答问题。

sentences.en: The lawyers are worried that Trump, who has a history of contradicting himself, could be charged with lying to Mueller's investigators.
sentences.zh: 律师们担心，有前后矛盾历史的特朗普可能会被指控对穆勒的调查人员撒谎。

sentences.en: But the advice puts them at odds with the president himself, who has publicly said he is eager to speak with the special counsel.
sentences.zh: 但这一建议使他们与总统本人产生了分歧，总统曾公开表示他渴望与特别检察官交谈。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日简报》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 那时选举迎进了一批自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一集的《都会》中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带你了解那些试图维持影响力却最终失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都会》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
